title: Links between References and to concepts, with vector suggestions and one Accept/Reject-with-reason UI
description:
Slice 2 of PPY-2e9064. People can link a Reference to other References ("relates to") and to concept wiki entries (hashtags); vector search suggests both; the editor accepts or rejects suggestions, with an optional reason, through the same component used for References and ideas. Turns on the hub and cluster signals.

Ryan's decisions (2026-11-01): tagging a Reference with a concept = a related_to edge (reference -> semanticNode), not a new predicate; accept/reject always offers the optional reason, and reasons train the site Cyclotrons; one standard Accept/Reject-with-reason UI shared by References, suggestions and ideas.

Data model: no new GraphQL models. Edges are SemanticRelation rows (predicates already in corpora/papyrus-semantic-relation-types.yml): relationState current (human or derived) / suggested (vector proposal; invisible to every existing #current reader) / rejected; provenance in metadata (design 2.1).

Deploy: resolver + UI = one batch bump of all seven sites (batch-site-bumps); router IAM for S3 Vectors = one change set. Done when every sub-task is closed and the acceptance checks in each pass on Anth.us.
Design: the design comment on the epic PPY-2e9064 (copied to docs/idea-context-packs.md by S1.0).
Owner rules that apply: no fixed caps, day windows or magic thresholds (derive or learn them; bound only by time, cost, context size); decisions go to decision models (Jev / the site Cyclotron), the LLM (GPT-6 Luna) only writes; Gherkin specs (narrative, complete) for every behaviour change; say "idea(s)", never "draft"/"proposed story".
UI rules: Lucide icons; buttons + textarea, no dropdowns or popovers; one Accept/Reject vocabulary; a text label beside every mark (never colour alone); no AppSync subscriptions; screenshot review by Ryan on a local dev server before merging.
